name: const unsafe fn copy < T > (src : * const T , dst : * mut T , count : usize)
rule: `dst` must remain valid for writes of `count * size_of::<T>()` bytes while `src` is read for `count * size_of::<T>()` bytes, including when the ranges overlap.
api: const unsafe fn copy < T > (src : * const T , dst : * mut T , count : usize)
